title: ceratopteris thalictroides subsp. gaudichaudii
intro: Ceratopteris thalictroides subsp. gaudichaudii, commonly known as Gaudichaud's water fern, is a species of aquatic fern native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Ocean. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gaudichaud's water fern include anti-inflammatory, anticoagulant, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
